# uptimekuma_notification_keep (Resource)

Keep notification resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimekuma_notification_keep" "example" {
  name        = "Keep Notifications"
  webhook_url = "https://api.keephq.dev/alerts/alert"
  api_key     = "your-keep-api-key"
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: webhook_url_wo and api_key_wo are
# never stored in plan or state. Change the matching *_wo_version whenever a
# secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_notification_keep" "write_only" {
  name = "Keep with write-only secrets"

  webhook_url_wo         = "https://api.keephq.dev/alerts/alert"
  webhook_url_wo_version = "1"
  api_key_wo             = "your-keep-api-key"
  api_key_wo_version     = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Notification name

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Keep API key for authentication. Stored in state; use `api_key_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Keep API key for authentication, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `api_key`; requires `api_key_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `api_key_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `api_key` until the next apply with `api_key_wo` set removes it from state.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `api_key_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `api_key_wo`.
- `apply_existing` (Boolean)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Keep webhook URL. Stored in state; use `webhook_url_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `webhook_url_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Keep webhook URL, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `webhook_url`; requires `webhook_url_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `webhook_url_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `webhook_url` until the next apply with `webhook_url_wo` set removes it from state.
- `webhook_url_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `webhook_url_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `webhook_url_wo`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Notification identifier
